deviations.owner: Agent 4 (webhook LEGO); port + gate by Agent 3
deviations.description: The reference CLI modules are DI + TypeORM + Redis bound and cannot be imported in the offline sandbox, so `webhook.service.ts` (registry matching), `webhook-request-sanitizer.ts`, `webhook-on-received-response-extractor.ts` and `webhook-response-headers.ts` are reconstructed as pure code and verified against a transcription of the reference source (tools/webhook-isolation-gate.mjs, W05/W06). The parts that DO exist in the pinned runtime — NodeHelpers.getNodeWebhookPath, NodeHelpers.getNodeWebhookUrl, WebhookPathTakenError, the node type constants — are compared against the executing n8n-workflow@2.9.1 build (W02/W03/W04). Both evidence classes are recorded in docs/isolation/evidence/webhook-lego-gate.json.

The registry keeps rows in memory instead of reading a TypeORM table through a Redis cache; WebhookResponseHeaders takes an injectable logger instead of Container.get(Logger); express Request/Response are duck-typed. WebhookService.storeWebhook upserts on (method, webhookPath) exactly like the reference — the 'path taken' error is raised by the activation conflict check (WebhookPathTakenError), not by the store.
